name: team-skills
description: Shared team skills for product workflows. Ships `plan` (bootstrap and maintain product plans under docs/plans/ with a mandatory simplest-vs-robust debate loop for greenfield and an opt-in debate for improvements) and `user-voice` (learn the user's writing voice from samples plus a short interview, then install it as a portable my-voice skill and/or a CLAUDE.md section so future sessions draft email/Slack/PR messages in their voice instead of sounding like AI).
